userStories.title: Create performance.py — cumulative P&L and system metrics calculator
userStories.description:
Current state: The base-trader has data/trade_log.jsonl (all trades), data/positions.json (open positions), data/signal_log.jsonl (all evaluations), and data/run_log.jsonl (pipeline runs). There is no script that computes cumulative system performance metrics.

What to build: Create businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/performance.py that:

1. Reads trade_log.jsonl and positions.json from the data/ directory

2. Computes these metrics:
   - total_realized_pnl_usd: sum of pnl_usd from all closed trades (SELL events in trade_log)
   - total_unrealized_pnl_usd: for each open position, (current_price - entry_price) / entry_price * position_usd
   - total_pnl_usd: realized + unrealized
   - trade_count: total trades (BUY + SELL events)
   - win_count: trades where pnl_pct > 0
   - loss_count: trades where pnl_pct <= 0
   - win_rate: win_count / max(win_count + loss_count, 1)
   - avg_winner_pct: mean pnl_pct of winning trades
   - avg_loser_pct: mean pnl_pct of losing trades
   - expectancy: (win_rate * avg_winner_pct) + ((1-win_rate) * avg_loser_pct)
   - avg_hold_hours: mean hold time across closed positions
   - max_drawdown_pct: largest peak-to-trough decline in cumulative P&L
   - total_signals_evaluated: count lines in signal_log.jsonl
   - signals_per_trade: total_signals_evaluated / max(trade_count, 1)
   - pipeline_runs: count lines in run_log.jsonl
   - avg_run_duration_s: mean of duration_s from run_log
   - total_credits_used: sum of credits_used from run_log

3. For unrealized P&L: get current price from GeckoTerminal (gt_get_token_info) for each open position. Import from gecko_terminal.py (same directory).

4. Output:
   - Print a formatted report to stdout
   - Write to data/performance_report.json (structured data)
   - Write to reports/performance-summary.md (human-readable Markdown)
   - Create reports/ directory if it doesn't exist

5. CLI: argparse with:
   - --data-dir (default: auto-detect from script location)
   - --json-only (skip Markdown output)

Constraints:
- Do NOT modify any existing script
- Import gt_get_token_info from gecko_terminal for current prices
- Handle the case where trade_log.jsonl has no SELL events (all unrealized)
- Handle empty positions.json gracefully
- Use sys.path.insert for sibling imports
acceptanceCriteria: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts'); from performance import compute_metrics; print('import OK PASS')"
